faqs.q: Does a Colorado Springs booking cost more than a Denver one?
faqs.a: One short travel line, covering the run down from Denver. Colorado Springs is a Front Range drive rather than a corridor one, so there is no lodging line and no mileage arithmetic. A holiday weekend prices above a standard date here as it does everywhere in this market.

faqs.q: Can you clear a defense contractor's vendor process?
faqs.a: Yes. We can be set up as a vendor, quote against a purchase order and invoice net-30 on approval, with a W-9 and a certificate of insurance naming your venue sent in the same email as the contract. Start onboarding when you shortlist dates; it is usually the slowest step in a corporate booking.

faqs.q: What size fits a Broadmoor-class ballroom party?
faqs.a: A quartet, once the floor has to fill. Dinner and remarks sit at 65 to 72 dBA, which a duo or trio holds comfortably; dancing runs 88 to 95 dBA, which is quartet work. One act can ladder across both halves of the night on a single contract.
